name: 1815 S. Prairie Avenue — the alley building of the house at 1815 (district draft; refined by T-1936)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads '2-storey brick GARAGE on the alley'. 1911 labels it a garage or barn; for 1904 the envelope is backcast and its use reconstructed as a stable/coach house. A small frame annex marked "R.CL. 3B" adjoins it; the notation is recorded unexpanded.
